title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Deferral of Acquisition)
Where an application for acquisition of a private investment was not filed by February 21, 1971, the Government may, if an application is filed thereafter, defer acquisition of that investment for five years from the date of the application.
